low.title: Full-Day Alba Iulia Art Route (Low Budget)
low.summary: Budget-friendly full-day art walk inside Alba Iulia’s citadel with creative corners, murals and simple local food.

schedule.title: Alba Carolina Fortress Gate I Start
schedule.description: Enter the star-shaped fortress and admire the sculpted Baroque gate decorations.

schedule.title: Citadel Street Murals & Sketch Corners
schedule.description: Hunt for small murals, painted doors and quirky details along the inner streets of the fortress.

schedule.title: Obelisk of Horea, Cloșca and Crișan (Artistic Monument)
schedule.description: Study the sculpted reliefs and geometric obelisk shape — great spot for artsy photos.

schedule.title: Budget Local Lunch in the Citadel
schedule.description: Simple Romanian dishes like bean stew, cabbage rolls or polenta at an affordable eatery.

schedule.title: Union Hall Exterior & Sculptures
schedule.description: View the historic Union Hall façade and nearby statues, focusing on symmetries and details.

schedule.title: Roman & Japanese Gardens Path
schedule.description: Follow the landscaped path near the fortress walls with themed gardens, statues and viewpoints.

schedule.title: Hidden Courtyard Art Corners
schedule.description: Explore side courtyards with small craft shops, handmade souvenirs and improvised gallery walls.

schedule.title: Sunset Walk on the Bastion Walls
schedule.description: End the day with warm light over the citadel and panoramic views full of textures and lines.

medium.title: Full-Day Alba Iulia Art Walk + Local Cuisine
medium.summary: A balanced art-focused day inside and around the citadel, combining architecture, small museums and classic Romanian dining.

schedule.title: Alba Carolina Fortress Main Gate
schedule.description: Start with monumental Baroque sculpture over the gate and decorative stonework.

schedule.title: Route of the Three Fortifications Viewpoints
schedule.description: Pause at glass-covered sections showing Roman and medieval remains under your feet.

schedule.title: National Museum of the Union (Exterior & Highlights)
schedule.description: Study the Romantic façade and visit a few key exhibition rooms with historic paintings and artifacts.

schedule.title: Local Romanian Lunch in the Citadel
schedule.description: Mid-range restaurant with hearty classics like ciorbă, sarmale and dessert dumplings.

schedule.title: Coronation Cathedral Courtyard
schedule.description: Walk through arcades painted with religious art and observe patterns, arches and fresco details.

schedule.title: Creative Craft Alley
schedule.description: Explore a short lane with workshops, ceramics, wood, icons and hand-painted souvenirs.

schedule.title: Roman & Japanese Garden Loop
schedule.description: Contrast between classical statues, trimmed hedges and minimalist garden design next to the walls.

schedule.title: Citadel Evening Lights & Statues
schedule.description: Finish with a slow walk by illuminated bastions, statues and city viewpoints.

high.title: Premium Art Day in Alba Iulia
high.summary: Curated full-day art route with interior museum time, guided-feel exploration and refined local dining.

schedule.title: Alba Carolina Fortress Artistic Gates
schedule.description: Take time at several fortress gates, focusing on sculptural groups, coats of arms and decorative stone carving.

schedule.title: National Museum of the Union (Focused Visit)
schedule.description: See selected rooms with historic paintings, statues and decorative objects — treat it like a curated gallery.

schedule.title: Union Hall & Memorial Sculptures
schedule.description: Observe the monumental façade, plaques and commemorative reliefs as pieces of public art.

schedule.title: Premium Romanian Lunch in the Citadel
schedule.description: Elegant restaurant with elevated versions of local dishes and careful presentation.

schedule.title: Principia Roman Museum Glass Floor
schedule.description: Walk above Roman ruins and look at the geometric traces of ancient walls and columns.

schedule.title: Roman & Japanese Gardens Photo Session
schedule.description: Artistic compositions with statues, trees, bridges and fortress walls in the background.

schedule.title: Hidden Atelier Courtyard
schedule.description: Stop in a small inner yard with local artists, framed prints and handmade objects.

schedule.title: Golden Hour on the Bastion Ramparts
schedule.description: Premium-feel sunset walk above the city, full of lines, textures and silhouettes.

comfortable.title: Luxury Artistic Journey Through Alba Iulia
comfortable.summary: A smooth, premium-feeling full-day art experience with refined architecture, curated museum stops and fine dining.

schedule.title: Citadel VIP Morning Stroll
schedule.description: Enter through a decorated gate and slowly cross the wide central promenade lined with statues.

schedule.title: National Museum of the Union (Relaxed Premium Visit)
schedule.description: Unhurried exploration of highlights — paintings, sculptures and historic artifacts presented in grand halls.

schedule.title: Coronation Cathedral Ensemble
schedule.description: Admire the cathedral towers, courtyard arcades and painted details like a large open-air art installation.

schedule.title: Fine Dining Local Lunch
schedule.description: Luxurious reinterpretation of Romanian flavors with beautiful plating and calm atmosphere.

schedule.title: Roman & Japanese Gardens Premium Walk
schedule.description: Carefully landscaped spaces ideal for photography and quiet observation.

schedule.title: Citadel Boutique Galleries & Design Shops
schedule.description: Browse small shops with icons, ceramics, textiles and modern crafts curated like tiny galleries.

schedule.title: Private-Feeling Bastion Route
schedule.description: Walk a quieter part of the fortress walls, focusing on viewpoints and geometric fortress lines.

schedule.title: Evening Lights & Monumental Silhouettes
schedule.description: End with illuminated gates, towers and statues glowing softly at dusk.
